mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the risk-free rate and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by at least 1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO 3m growth is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior three months indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly average.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer credit demand (RSAFS growth > 1.0% monthly), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening in the housing sector, which is a key component of consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS growth exceeds 1.0% and HOUST declines by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and a federal funds rate below 0.5% signal a dual economic shock of weak supply and excessive monetary accommodation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
